data.body: RCA: the existing CI workflow parity tests prove shared reusable wiring and several fixed gate/script signatures, but they do not parse and compare the optional dependency extras installed by the Verified gating test lane versus the scheduled/dispatch sweep interpreter lane. Commit c57057f41 could therefore add grounding-terraform to the gating install without adding either the same sweep install or an explicit in-tree exception, leaving sweep-only failures invisible to the parity guard. Fix direction: add a narrow unit-level invariant in tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py that extracts uv install extras from the two lane install steps, permits only declared intentional sweep omissions, names each extra/direction on failure, and asserts the historical c57057f41 workflow pair would fail without such a declaration.
